cd /workspace/tmp/tests && cat > stress3.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, os, random, resource, sys, time, io
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/tmp/tests','/opt/emicro-deps','/workspace/project']
import driver
rng=random.Random(9)
NS=16
names=['S%02d'%i for i in range(NS)]
reg=[{'name':n,'label':4294967290-i} for i,n in enumerate(names)]   # full u32-ish epochs and labels
LIM={'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
# 16 stages, each ~250 words of length 16 == 4000 path services (total 64000 <= 65536)
policies=[]
for k in range(16):
    ws=set()
    while len(ws)<250: ws.add(tuple(rng.choice(names) for _ in range(16)))
    policies.append(' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(w) for w in ws))
print('total path services', sum(p.count(',')+1 for p in policies))
events=[{'op':'stage','epoch':4294967000+k,'policy':policies[k]} for k in range(16)]
events.append({'op':'commit','epoch':4294967015})
for i in range(1,300): events.append({'op':'spawn','unit':[4294967295,i,4294967295],'service':names[i%NS]})
while len(events)<200000: events.append({'op':'inspect'})
j={'services':reg,'limits':LIM,'events':events}
data=json.dumps({'jobs':[j]},separators=(',',':')).encode()
print('input bytes',len(data),'events',len(events))
t=time.time()
buf=io.BytesIO()
w=driver.Writer(buf, chunk=1<<21)
driver.run(data,w); w.flush()
dt=time.time()-t
print('run %.2fs output %d bytes (%.1f MiB)'%(dt,buf.tell(),buf.tell()/1048576))
print('peak rss MiB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
head=buf.getvalue(400) if hasattr(buf,'getvalue') else b''
print(buf.getvalue()[:300])
PYEOF
